name: Annual mean PM2.5 (CHR county measure)
source: County Health Rankings & Roadmaps 2025 County layer, Monterey County row; underlying measure source is Environmental Public Health Tracking Network
notes: The exact Monterey County row (FIPS 06053) reports v125_rawvalue=8.8. The field alias is 'Average daily amount of fine particulate matter in micrograms per cubic meter'; its descriptor says the measure is average daily density of PM2.5, source Environmental Public Health Tracking Network, Year(s): 2020. CHR row field `year=2025` is release year; observation year is 2020. This predates the framework's five-year acceptance window as of October 2026 and must be treated as stale/recency-flagged, not as a current estimate. CHR methods explain that modeled daily county estimates select the maximum among census-tract-centroid estimates, rather than a population-weighted county spatial mean; the measure is a general pattern/trend indicator and does not directly reflect individual exposure. Methodology: https://www.countyhealthrankings.org/health-data/community-conditions/physical-environment/air-water-and-land/air-pollution-particulate-matter. Tier 1/2 searches found no newer countywide annual mean in accessible Monterey County, MBARD, CARB, or EPA sources; local CARB/MBARD monitor readings are site-specific and were not averaged.
